chunks: 4139 - Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said regarding game in which an arrow was found while it was dead, and it was not known who killed it. He said: “Do not eat it.”

And he said: “Whoever wounds with a weapon and mentions the Name of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, then the game remains for a night or two, then he finds it, and no predator has eaten from it, and he knows that his weapon killed it, then let him eat from it, if Allah wills.”

key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the Name of Allah invoked at the time of hunting
key_terms.بِسِلَاحٍ: with a weapon used for hunting
key_terms.جَرَحَ: wounded the animal in the course of hunting
key_terms.سَبُعٌ: a predatory beast that might have eaten from the game
key_terms.سَهْمٌ: an arrow found in the hunted animal
key_terms.صَيْدٍ: game animal that has been hunted
key_terms.لَا تَطْعَمُوهُ: do not eat it; a prohibition on consuming it

ai.seo_question: When is hunted game lawful to eat if it is found dead later with an arrow or weapon wound?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning hunted game. If a dead animal is found with an arrow in it but its killer is unknown, it is not to be eaten; but if the hunter invoked Allah's Name, knows his weapon caused the death, and no predator has eaten from it, then it may be eaten even if found after one or two nights.
